thread:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: Horizon VPC cutover tomorrow 05:00 UTC. Quick async sync — listing blockers and owners below, please react/assign. TL;DR: need egress IP confirmation, airgap artifact signing, proxy cert rotation, firewall port list, and canary smoke owner. Who can take egress IPs/ASN?

Maya Singh: I can take egress IPs. Will confirm exact range + announce in NET ticket by EOD. Do we have the TF pool id?

Alex Chen: Pool id is `hzn-egress-pool-2` (Terraform). Maya pls confirm reservation + ASN with NetOps.

Ravi Patel: Airgap artifact signing still blocked by security SC key rotation. @Ops-SRE any fallback if key rotation slips? We need a way to get images into the airgapped registry.

Ops-SRE: We can fallback to uploading signed tarballs to S3 + presigned URL + HMAC verification on host. Need list of images + digests. Share them in this thread and I’ll generate presigned links.

Jordan Lee: Canary smoke window = 06:00-06:30 UTC after cutover. I’ll own smoke tests and rollback criteria. Quick smoke commands for reference:
```bash
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %time_total" https://horizon.example-corp.com/health
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' -X POST https://horizon.example-corp.com/api/v1/echo -d '{"ping":"pong"}'
```

NetOps Bot: Egress IPs reserved: 34.210.11.45 assigned to Horizon (ticket NET-4821).

Maya Singh: Confirmed reservation. I pushed TF change in PR #8123: `egress_pool = "hzn-egress-pool-2"`. @Alex can you do a quick review?

Alex Chen: Reviewing PR now. Firewall team requires destination port list and CIDR ranges we will hit from the cluster — Jordan, can you confirm ports?

Jordan Lee: Ports we use outbound: 443 (artifact registry, control plane), 5222 (metrics shipper), 9411 (tracing), plus 443 for health checks. Short list: 443, 5222, 9411. Destination CIDRs: artifact-registry (52.19.0.0/20), metrics (34.88.12.0/24).

Ravi Patel: Security note: edge proxy crit rotation scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Ops-SRE, please verify chain includes customer CA and update runbook step if CN changes.

Ops-SRE: Verified chain in staging includes customer CA. For prod we need the additional SAN entry (customer CN). @Maya can you provide exact CN to include in CSR?

Maya Singh: Customer CN is `horizon.example-corp.com`. I will add it to the CSR request and upload to the cert ticket.

Alex Chen: Owners summary: Maya = egress/netops, Jordan = canary/smoke & ports, Ravi = security/artifacts, Ops-SRE = runbook/fallback. I added the checklist to the rollout board: https://redwood.infra/rollouts/6490001111 — please update status in the board when done. If any blocker remains at T-1h, ping here and we can delay. :thumbsup:

NetOps Bot: Reminder: deploy window locked until approvals from #eng-security are present.

Jordan Lee: I’ll post the final smoke runbook and expected logs 1h before cutover.

Maya Singh: PR #8123 updated with netops approval comment. Marking egress as assigned.

Ravi Patel: Posting list of images for Ops-SRE: `redwood/horizon-proxy:1.4.2`, `redwood/horizon-runtime:3.2.0`, `sidecar/metrics-shipper:0.8.1`. Will add digests to the ticket.

Alex Chen: Perfect — thanks all. Final callout: if the SC key rotation blocks artifact signing, we switch to Ops-SRE presigned tarballs and delay non-critical canaries. Last check here at 03:30 UTC.
